categories.test-arrangement-rhyme: Two tests of one surface, or two phases of one scenario, sharing an arrange/act block above jscpd's token threshold. This repository's own policy already treats this as the expected shape of test code, not debt (see the sibling AST structural-duplication guard's _ACCEPTED_TESTS): collapsing it into one parametrized case would hide which configuration or phase failed.
categories.migration-revision-boilerplate: Each Alembic revision under database/migrations/versions/ is an immutable record of one schema change. The shared column, index and CHECK scaffolding across revisions is the migration convention, not debt: making a later revision depend on an earlier one's helper would break replay independence.

accepted.note: Both build the minimal clarification-node-pair graph (producer + proceed + gate, one question set) to park a run, but for different transports: test_clarification_edge parks directly via graph.ainvoke on the app's own checkpointer, while test_clarification_relay_sse feeds the same park through a real worker producer and worker bridge over a real socket so the relayed SSE frame is genuine. A shared helper would couple the direct-invoke test module to the socket-relay test module's transport plumbing for one 24-line graph-builder; each already folds its own in-module duplication (see the removed same-file entries this round).

Both seed a thread parked at a document-approval gate with an authoring checkpoint, but _seed_parked_thread (non-live) takes a general _ParkedThreadSeed (many proposal/changeset ids, optional gate_pending, an explicit checkpointer.setup()) while _seed_parked_gate (live) is deliberately single-proposal-shaped to match the live round-trip scenarios and skips the setup call its suite's checkpointer fixture already does. Merging them would make the live-engine suite's seed shape depend on the deterministic suite's more general one, or force the deterministic suite to carry live-only fields it never uses.
